name: Dhu Al Jalaali Wa Al Ikraam
description: Allah possesses majesty and honour and bestows generosity upon His creation.
summary: Dhu Al Jalaali Wa Al Ikraam joins majesty with honour and generosity. Allah possesses perfect greatness and bestows honour and bounty upon His creation. This name invites reverence for His majesty and gratitude for His generous care.
